question: An analyst has been asked to summarise a spreadsheet of customer complaints that includes names and account numbers. Which sequence of steps is correct?
options: A) Confirm the policy for this data; remove identifiers not needed; run the summary in the approved workspace; store the output under the same rules.
B) Run the summary in the approved workspace; confirm the policy for this data; store the output under the same rules; remove identifiers not needed.
C) Store the output under the same rules; remove identifiers not needed; confirm the policy for this data; run the summary in the approved workspace.
D) Remove identifiers not needed; run the summary in the approved workspace; store the output under the same rules; confirm the policy for this data.
correct_answers: A) Confirm the policy for this data; remove identifiers not needed; run the summary in the approved workspace; store the output under the same rules.
explanations: Correct. Clear the use, minimise the data, do the work where it is permitted, then keep the output under the same controls.
Full identifiers are processed first and stripped only at the very end.
An output is stored before it has been produced, which reverses the whole task.
The work is completed before anyone confirms it was permitted.
